what_it_provides: The ETUS Annaba page (id 100063517660926). Page name confirmed: الشركة الوطنية للنقل الحضري و الشبه الحضري عنابة / ETUS Annaba. Login-walled to a fetcher - title only came back, no posts, no line list, no contacts. Same wall as on the 2026-09-03 operator-source check.

**New finding, not in the registry.** 'Etus Annaba', package **com.deeper.etus.annaba**, developer **Deeper Tech (deepertech.dz)**, v1.0.0, updated 2024-06-19, 10,000+ installs. Deeper Tech is the vendor of the com.deeper.etus.* family that androydi documents as the OFFICIAL public-urban-transport apps (e.g. com.deeper.etus.souk for Souk Ahras, com.deeper.etus.aindf for Aïn Defla). Description says it shows ETUS Annaba bus positions and supports fare payment. The Play page itself returned 404 to a fetcher on two URL forms; details come from the search index, APKPure and apkcombo mirrors. NO line list in the store text.
licence_or_terms_seen: None. No open feed advertised. Live-position endpoints deliberately NOT called.

what_it_provides: 'Annaba BUS', the registry's existing third_party_app_claim lead. Same org.<city>.manager family as Constantine's Cirta Bus. Confirmed to still exist; no line list retrieved. Secondary to com.deeper.etus.annaba.

'Safer Annaba - سافر عنابة', developer Safer DZ, v1.0, 2021-03-27. Self-described verbatim: 'سافر عنابة، خدمة الية لتسيير النقل العمومي لمدينة عنابة بخرائط طرق ذكية / Service Informatique de Gestion de Transport de la ville de Annaba par des Maps interactifs'. A third-party Annaba public-transport routing product with interactive maps - the only artefact found that plausibly holds an Annaba line graph. Does not name ETUS Annaba as operator. Aptoide does not expose the package id.
licence_or_terms_seen: None stated. Third-party; no reuse grant.

what_it_provides: Checked because searches conflate it with 'Safer Annaba'. It is NOT the Annaba urban product: it is a national multimodal intercity booking platform (carpooling, intercity coach, train). Annaba appears only as an intercity destination with fares. No urban line data. Recorded so the next researcher does not re-check it.
licence_or_terms_seen: General terms, privacy and refund pages exist; no data licence.

what_it_provides: Direction des transports de la wilaya d'Annaba, official page, id **61553735315894**. Found via search; login-walled like every other operator page. Lead: the DTW publishes line-opening decisions, which is what the Aïn Defla and Constantine breakthroughs looked like.

Akher Saa / local Annaba press. Gives network CONTEXT, not lines: three station upgrade operations funded by the local-authorities fund, of which **Kouche Noureddine (كوش نور الدين) station serves the semi-urban routes toward Sidi Amar, El Hadjar and Dhraa Errich**, and **Souidani Boudjemaa station serves the urban buses**. This is what lets the OSM candidates be interpreted at all - see osm-match.md.
